The earlier ITER-admission and scaled-convergence defects are repaired. Native admission-negative-control/gate.log reports 5 failed, 41 deselected in 6.28s, EXIT=1. review-admission-current-head.log names exactly those five tests PASSED, 5 passed, 41 deselected in 19.03s, EXIT=0 at ee02bc413dc71e7e9fdf0c0172985c0ebb0f0313. The source files covered by the suite are byte-identical from the measured 28458e75651b4ec1e263dbe76a711ccb837ab290 through the reviewed head. Neither focused success nor byte identity supplies the missing complete suite result. The controller's negative_control_admitted=true based on an aborted head's empty IDs is explicitly rejected by the source evidence fragment:2038-2046.

The complete failure-set delta is unavailable: added_failure_count=null, added_failure_ids=[] means not captured, never zero added failures. Native baseline/head log hashes match the source manifest. Partial F progress markers are not assigned a test identity. The known earlier default-route failure is not inferred to be that unidentified marker.

Fitted-source row replay receipts were opened directly for MAST-U, TCV and ITER. Loop/probe relative L2 errors are respectively 0.0012641012612455412/0.0010252620601982304, 0.0016982263557521813/0.0019015528117356548, and 0.007242617899855864/0.0008395208013880012. Current-integral errors are below 1.8e-15 and the replay tests explicitly require nonzero plasma and vacuum probe responses before discussing zero families. Zero-reference families correctly retain null relative error. This supports the plan's 5% replay prerequisite, not successful inverse reconstruction.

Assertion independence: no numerical assertion was found which remains true merely because both sides echo the same supplied value. The trip-count check compares the serialized result with a constructed four-attempt history while checking three finite entries separately; reinstating finite-only counting returns 3 and fails the attempt-count assertion. The conductor fit has independently built design and numpy.linalg.lstsq expected coefficients; dropping current priors or their unequal weights changes the expected solution. The stubbed comparison checks assert policy/reporting only and are not credited as a physical scaled-data experiment. Restoring unconditional ITER bands fails its different-constraints test; restoring displacement-only admission fails the three stationary-fit tests and qualified-forward test. The structured assertion audit lists added assertion predicates, their failure conditions, and regression mechanisms below.

Production reachability: no production constructor invokes the new conductor-fitting mode; public exports alone are not counted as calls. The existing referee and Magnetics.project consumers were opened at the reviewed revision; their default paths retain their previous behavior. Segmented loops explicitly refuse project() because its input lacks segment-sample fields; the fitter reads loop_quadrature instead.

Reuse search: searches covered weighted fitting, observation projection/quadrature, supplied-equilibrium metrics, coefficient conversion, case/source builders, stationary-point polish, contour painters and JSON receipts. MagneticsFit and whitened_solve remain owners of fitting; Magnetics owns sensor projection; _boundary_distance is reused inside its referee owner; _profile_basis converts endpoint-constrained Bernstein coefficients to powers, whereas nova/linalg/basis.py:78 and interpolant.py evaluate bases. Existing forward-reference builders, FluxSurfaceGeometry, observation_kernels, polish_stationary_points and nova.media painters are reused. A concrete duplicate was found in strict receipt writing: nova/io/json.py owns atomic durable replacement, while the new helper adds strict JSON encoding in a second replacement implementation. This is why reuse is capped at 5 under the rubric.

Figure limitation: sixteen stored producer PNG previews were visually opened, including the three fitted-current replays, original and bound-input replays, original/refitted-start terminal panels, both later-state panels and the final response-refusal panel. Legends and text are legible and unclipped; contour gaps remain readable. Absence of blue shared-level contours on some refusal panels follows the reported refusal and is not interpreted as a matching field. These are existing producer previews, not a fresh independent render of the committed SVGs. The sandbox lacks rsvg-convert, and this bounded read-only review did not submit a new rendering job or run a figure batch on the fleet node. Fresh SVG rendering remains a validation limitation.
